create.title: Hard-M1 squarefree-radical coordinates and strict target-safe sectors
create.statement_tex: For every literal middle or lower residual frequency shell of the unique hard M1 profile and each sign sigma, zero-extend the complete actual symbol and define C_(L,X)^sigma(r) by exact divisor regrouping. Then T_(L,sigma)^M1=sum_(mu^2(s)=1)sum_(t>=1) C_(L,X)^sigma(st^2)e(sigma t sqrt(Xs)) exactly and multiplicity-preservingly. If G=(h,n), uniquely h=G d a^2, n=G e b^2, s=de, t=Gab, with d,e squarefree, (da,eb)=1, Geb odd, and G|t. Literal support gives st^2 asymp L^2, s<<L^2, and s>L implies t<<sqrt(L). Uniformly, the absolute mass of s<=L together with the disjoint sector s>L, t>=ceil(sqrt(L)) is <<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon. The exact unresolved complement is s>L, 1<=t<ceil(sqrt(L)), including the complete t=1 coprime-squarefree literal cone. All Vaaler, profile, power, floor, star, sign, strict-edge, hard-sample, real-X crossing, and zero-extension fields are retained. This is a strict reduction only and proves no estimate for the remaining complement.

create.title: Hard-M1 radical Möbius, Mellin, and joint-multiplier self-return obstruction
create.statement_tex: Let F_sigma(r)=C_(L,X)^sigma(r)e(sigma sqrt(Xr)) and K_L(b,u)=sum_(a|u, a^2b>L)mu(a). The complete literal high-radical sum H_(L,sigma) equals sum_(b,u)K_L(b,u)F_sigma(bu^2) exactly. Since K_L(b,u)=1_(u=1) for b>L, for every L one has H_(L,sigma)=T_(L,sigma)^M1+E_(L,sigma), where E_(L,sigma)=sum_(b<=L,u)K_L(b,u)F_sigma(bu^2)-sum_(r<=L)F_sigma(r) and E_(L,sigma)<<_epsilon L^(3/2)X^epsilon. Thus complete squarefree Mobius linearization returns the original hard cone modulo a target-safe correction, and joint (s,t) lifting is only a permutation of product indices. Coefficient-uniform capacity is L^2 already on the t=1 odd coprime-squarefree cone, but this is not literal lower mass. For the full-orientation Mellin fibre, odd 3 mod 4 prime exponent cancellation kills only tau=0; the truncated literal cone requires all inverse-Mellin modes and endpoints. This parks complete inversion/recombination, central-mode-only, positive noncentral-mode, coefficient-uniform, character-erased, and multiplier-averaging closures only. It neither refutes the literal small-t target nor proves a parent or exponent.
